body:
Make role-aware model selection default to the model assigned to that role.

### Scope
- When an agent or run is associated with a role, preselect that role's default model from task:6165fb16c328435a.
- Use the role's backup only when the default model is unavailable or unconfigured.
- Keep the selection editable: an explicit human choice overrides the role default and is shown as an override.
- Apply the default to new selections or runs, without silently changing an existing run's model.
- Keep the board API and Settings UI consistent about which assignment supplied the value.
- Add focused tests for default selection, backup fallback, manual override and existing-run preservation.

### Acceptance criteria
- Opening a role-aware model selector starts with the role's configured default when available.
- Unavailable defaults fall back to the configured backup and then the existing model fallback.
- An explicit selection is preserved and visibly distinguished from the role default.
- Existing runs are not rewritten when role assignments change.

### Out of scope
Defining roles, editing role assignments, provider setup, brief generation, Autorun task selection, and changing model behavior after a run starts.
title: Agent roles: default models
